name: WaveHaven Surf House & Hostel
description: Multi-step surf house hostel booking engine with WhatsApp auto-responders triggered by booking status changes (confirmed, cancelled, checked-in), multi-language support (English, Spanish, Arabic) across UI & WhatsApp, separated admin management panel with staff authentication gate, active admin profile menu with 1-click logout, waitlist auto-flagging with 1-click booking conversion, live ocean weather & wave forecast by sport with global search, QR code camera scanner for instant booking lookup, brand theme customizer, monthly occupancy percentage chart, and comprehensive operations dashboard.
